adaptation.reason: The unit-square label contradicts every supplied option. Retained the unit length, cut-out geometry and cone construction, restored the omitted assembly/tangency relations, and replaced the impossible choice answer with an exact value.

audit.independent_solution: Let sector radius be R and base-disk radius r. Equality of circumference and quarter-sector arc gives r=R/4. The disk center is (1−r,1−r), and tangency to the sector gives √2(1−r)=R+r. Thus R=4√2/(5+√2)≈0.88192484. Every original option (2,4,6,8) exceeds the square side 1 and is impossible.
